review:
BGaming's classic features rolled into one: adjustable paylines with flexible stakes, expanding wilds, and a Hold & Win bonus with a progress bar.

The Hold & Win starts with three respins and only sticky bells can land. A progress bar tracks the bells, and hitting 15 or 20 multiplies your win by 2x or 3x – so you're always watching that bar. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max, 97% RTP. Pick this over the 100-line version if you want to choose your lines.
